scope: Only fixed official artifact identity, transport, archive byte boundaries, framed text export, failure retention and one registered push branch. No artifact/native/test/helper execution or business acceptance.

independent_official_identity.method: Two read-only official API GETs; no ZIP download by reviewer
independent_official_identity.job: Exact job113654983347 is required by the prepared workflow; reviewer did not separately re-fetch its endpoint in this review.

fixed_issues.before: Directory branches skipped stream/empty/CRC checking and could coexist with a complete regular-file export.
fixed_issues.after: Each directory uses the same bounded actual read_small stream/size/CRC validator and must have empty actual payload; failure enters errors and prevents complete.
fixed_issues.verification: Independent full v1/v2 byte diff and static branch review; no dynamic control claimed.

fixed_issues.before: Foreign ValueError from URL parsing could be printed verbatim before fixed-point credential checks.
fixed_issues.after: Only the new custom ExportError is printed as a reason. Its only constructors use fixed non-sensitive reason strings. Other exceptions expose type and fixed redaction text, including port/URL parsing ValueError.
fixed_issues.verification: All constructors, need call sites and exception/output sites read; no network fault injection.

authentication: Bearer token exists only in this step environment, is popped from os.environ and cleared after download/finally.
Authenticated request requires fixed API prefix plus exact api.github.com hostname; all actual authenticated suffixes are constants or fixed numeric IDs.
HTTPRedirectHandler disables automatic forwarding. Each approved HTTPS storage locator is fetched with authenticated=False and fresh headers lacking Authorization.
Storage host/443/userinfo/fragment constraints and bounded repeated-percent-decoding token rejection remain. Signed locator is never written to request receipt or emitted.
Metadata bodies containing the current credential are rejected before saving. External URL/network/parse exception strings are not printed.
Redirects <=5; per-request timeout30s and download loop240s; job timeout10min. No automatic retries or run mutation.
transport: Official run ID/head/attempt/terminal failure and repository are required; exact job ID/run/head/attempt/failure required; exact artifact ID/name/size/digest/expiry and run/source/repository IDs required.
Archive streamed to exclusive .partial; exact5206420bytes and SHA256 fe9bb645c4d7036c542beaa708572793105825ae1ec11244d9293701e3da58af checked before rename/read. Partial original remains on failure.
Original official metadata, successful original ZIP or partial, and receipt retained under a unique RUNNER_TEMP directory; always upload uses this directory only.
archive: Exactly12 directory entries required; noncanonical/absolute/traversal/backslash/NUL/duplicate/file-directory-collision names rejected.
Encrypted/special/symlink kinds rejected; no filesystem extraction ever uses entry paths.
Local/central header names/flags/method/sizes where present and payload/central bounds checked; member header+payload overlap rejected.
Selected STORED/DEFLATE members decoded directly from fixed ZIP payload boundaries. Actual DEFLATE EOF required, no unconsumed/unused data, output<=256KiB, actual size and CRC match.
Directories also consume and verify their stream/CRC and must have zero actual payload.

Large/nontext/unselected regular members are not decompressed or independently CRC-certified. Their exact compressed bytes remain protected by the whole fixed ZIP SHA and retained ZIP; their omission is explicit and prevents complete.
byte_export: Selected UTF-8 text must decode strictly, but exported payload is the original unchanged bytes encoded in base64, not JSON reserialization.
Per-member maximum256KiB; total exported ORIGINAL bytes2MiB; frame payload16KiB. This is not a2MiB cap on encoded logs, which include about4/3 base64 expansion and framing.

Begin/end records carry artifact/ZIP/member identity, original size/SHA and frame count; each frame has sequence/offset/size/SHA/base64. Emptyfiles have explicit zero-frame begin/end and empty-byte digest.
All regular members must actually export and errors must be empty for complete/exit0. Oversized, invalid, unselected or over-total members retain excluded_reason and force incomplete/exit2.
No output status claims native success, root cause or TODO acceptance.
failure_preservation: Initial running receipt exists before API processing; request metadata and member progress are saved incrementally.
Any root error stays failed/exit2; individual directory/member errors survive to incomplete/exit2 while remaining eligible exports continue.
Always upload retains original ZIP/partial/metadata/receipt even on failure; if-no-files-found:error does not silently succeed.
The preexisting G2 nativefailure remains unchanged even if byte transport later completes.

remaining_execution_limits.next: Root may prepare and verify the exact candidate workflow object and one normal push under the approved scope. Read the first actual receipt and reconstruct frames by their hashes; preserve any real transport/incomplete failure. No additional native run or task gate is authorized by this static report.
